# ASAKAN (บริษัท อัสสกาญจน์ จำกัด)

> ASAKAN is a Bangkok condominium developer founded in 2001, building quality low-rise condominiums near main roads and rail transit at accessible prices. Brand idea: "Beyond Expectations".

## Current projects

- [Wela Ramkhamhaeng](https://www.asakan.co.th/projects/wela-ramkhamhaeng): Ramkhamhaeng 186, Bangkok. 0 metres from the MRT. Starting at 1.39 million baht.
- [Elysium Phahol 59](https://www.asakan.co.th/elysium59): Phahonyothin 59, Bangkok. 30 metres from BTS Green Line. Starting at 2.09 million baht.
- The Celine Bang Chan Station: Bang Chan, Bangkok. 150 metres to MRT Pink Line Bang Chan station. Starting at 1.42 million baht.
- Elysium Ram Interchange: Ramkhamhaeng, Bangkok. Coming soon.

## Track record

- 2001: company founded
- 2002: first condominium handed over
- 2007: 1,000 units handed over
- 2017: 2,500 units handed over
- 2024: 4,000 units handed over
- 2025: Elysium Phahol 59 launched
